[[New California Republic Army]] |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} '''NCR soldiers''' are members of [[New California Republic]] remnant forces who appear in [[Fallout TV series season 1|season 1]] of {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== After the collapse of the NCR in the [[Los Angeles]] area due to the destruction of [[Shady Sands]], these members of the [[New California Republic Army]] were stationed at [[Griffith Observatory]] before they were [[Battle of Griffith Observatory|wiped]] out by the [[Brotherhood of Steel]]. The NCR soldiers include [[Moldaver's elite guard]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Beginning]]=== When Griffith Observatory is attacked by [[Brotherhood of Steel]] forces, these soldiers, as well as several [[NCR citizen (TV series)|civilian combatants]], participate in the [[Battle of Griffith Observatory]]. ==Appearances== These NCR soldiers appear {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|8=108}} ==Behind the scenes== The soldiers are portrayed by various stunt performers and uncredited extras. ;Stunt performers * [[Bryce Biederman]] * [[David Chen]] * [[Justice Hedenberg]] * [[Warren E.
